nodes.name: Schedule Trigger (1-5min)
nodes.notes: Per design.md D2: n8n stays cron+fetch only, no RDF-ification. Cadence (2min here, tune 1-5min per PRD) is INTENTIONALLY finer than the 1h candle beta most ticks land on an in-progress candle. That is expected and safe: docs/architecture-notes.md documents that runCycle is a pure function of its input candles (no wall-clock reads), so repeated /api/cycle calls against an unchanged/in-progress candle are idempotent no-ops (tests/cycle/idempotency.test.ts), not a bug to engineer around with cadence alignment.

nodes.name: Fetch Klines - BTCUSDT
nodes.notes: Raw fetch only (D2) - one HTTP Request node per allowlisted asset (src/market/assets.ts), limit=50 to match the system's uniform per-cycle window (see design.md 'Why 50'). Feeds into a per-branch Set node (below) that hardcodes this branch's symbol, so the Aggregate node never has to infer it from item order. onError routes a Binance failure/rate-limit to this node's dedicated ERROR output pin (main[1]), left intentionally unconnected. main[0] then yields 0 items for that asset and the other assets still reach /api/cycle — mirroring runCycle's 'skip a zero-candle asset, don't error' semantics.

nodes.name: Set Symbol - BTCUSDT
nodes.notes: Attaches this branch's literal symbol plus the raw klines array under a stable 'klines' field, so the Aggregate Code node downstream never needs to infer the asset from item order (fixes the previous SYMBOLS[i] positional fragility).

nodes.name: Merge Assets
nodes.notes: Fan-in for the 3 per-asset branches. Without this, all 3 Set Symbol nodes fed the SAME Aggregate input and n8n's bare `items` global resolved to branch 0 only, silently dropping 2 of 3 assets every cycle. Append mode = flat concat of inputs 0..2 (Merge v3 mode/append.ts). A branch that produced 0 items (its Fetch node routed to its error output) contributes nothing and does not block the others.

nodes.name: Aggregate (build /api/cycle payload)
nodes.notes: Only reshapes raw Binance kline arrays [openTime,open,high,low,close,volume,...] into the Candle[] shape app/api/cycle/route.ts expects ({symbol, klines:[{openTime,open,high,low,close,volume}]}). No RDF, no indicator math, no decision logic here - all of that stays server-side (D2). Reads item.json.symbol/item.json.klines directly, both hardcoded/attached by the per-branch Set node upstream - no positional item-order inference.

nodes.name: POST /api/cycle
nodes.notes: MANUAL STEP 1 - replace REPLACE_WITH_YOUR_DEPLOYED_APP_URL in the url with your real deployed app origin. MANUAL STEP 2 - create a Header Auth credential named exactly 'FAF Cycle Shared Secret' with Name=x-faf-shared-secret and Value=<your FAF_CYCLE_SHARED_SECRET>, then select it here. T-2: the secret is NEVER stored in this JSON - n8n excludes credential values from workflow export. $env is not usable: n8n Cloud exposes no custom $env, and $vars requires Pro/Enterprise (this instance is Starter).
